decisions.reason: The relaunch SEO service has had its own page for two years and sits at the core of the firm's announced full-service shop-relaunch and search-marketing offering, so the firm has a visible, central commitment it will continue to justify at little ongoing cost.

The SEO workshops were launched only in 2024 with their own page and extend the firm's search-marketing expertise, so any weak early demand is easy to attribute to the ramp-up phase and the firm is likely to persist with them.
